description: This file defines the PdfTextAnnotation class, a .NET class that models a text annotation in a PDF. It includes properties for display options such as icon type and open state, and manages internal annotation elements.

classes.name: PdfTextAnnotation
classes.description: Represents a text annotation in a PDF document, allowing configuration of display options such as icon type and whether it is initially open.

methods.name: PdfTextAnnotation
methods.description: Default constructor that initializes a new text annotation.

methods.name: PdfTextAnnotation
methods.description: Constructor that initializes a new text annotation associated with a specific PDF document.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Sets default properties for the annotation, such as subtype and icon.

methods.name: Open (property)
methods.description: Gets or sets a flag indicating if the annotation appears initially open.

methods.name: Icon (property)
methods.description: Gets or sets the icon used to display the annotation, such as Comment, Help, etc.
